findings.message: Enabled literal button has no detectable action or submit behavior.
findings.remediation: Connect the button to a real action, make it a submit button, or disable/remove it.

findings.message: Base scrollbar theming is activated by an opt-in class.
findings.remediation: Apply base scrollbar tokens globally; reserve classes for geometry or semantic exceptions.

findings.message: Scrollbar theme does not provide both standards-based scrollbar properties.
findings.remediation: Add global scrollbar-color and scrollbar-width standards properties plus fallbacks.
